methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected primarily from each vendor's official pricing or subscription page and from Apple App Store US listings (apps.apple.com), which display consumer-facing prices in USD. Where an official web pricing page returned 4xx/403 or rendered JavaScript-only with no extractable prices, the Apple App Store listing for the US region was used as the primary source and is noted in provenance. A second independent source (review site, app-store listing, or third-party editorial) was used for corroboration wherever available. 'Calm for Teams' (5–300 seats) publishes self-serve per-seat pricing at health.calm.com; Calm Health (enterprise) and Headspace for Organizations (enterprise) are quote-only. Waking Up's official website (wakingup.com/subscribe) shows a web-direct annual price of $129.99, which is lower than the Apple App Store price ($149.99) due to Apple's platform fee; the web-direct price is recorded as the canonical self-serve price. Aura Health's official website (aurahealth.io) does not display pricing on publicly accessible pages; pricing is sourced from mindbodygreen.com editorial coverage (2023) and flagged accordingly — treat as approximate. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null for every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. hipaa and baa are null unless explicitly stated by the vendor.

vendors.name: Calm
vendors.provenance: Apple App Store US listing (apps.apple.com/us/app/calm/id571800810, accessed 2026-06-14) returned confirmed USD prices for individual monthly, annual, and lifetime tiers. Family plan price corroborated by medicalnewstoday.com editorial review. Calm's own pricing page (calm.com/pricing) returned HTTP 403. Calm for Teams pricing from health.calm.com/teams (accessed 2026-06-14).

plans.name: Premium Monthly
plans.notes: Month-to-month recurring billing. Includes full access to Calm's meditation, sleep stories, and music library. 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: Premium Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $69.99/year (~$5.83/month). Month-to-month rate is $14.99. Annual discount approximately 61% vs monthly. 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: Family Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $99.99/year (~$8.33/month) for up to 6 accounts. Per-person cost is ~$1.39/month at full 6-person household.

plans.name: Lifetime
plans.notes: One-time purchase of $499.99 for permanent access to the Calm library (raised from $399.99; multiple 2026 sources confirm $499.99). No recurring subscription. monthlyUsd is null because this is a one-time payment — price recorded here only.

plans.name: Teams (per seat, annual)
plans.notes: Self-serve for 5–300 seats. Billed as $70.00/seat/year (~$5.83/seat/month), paid upfront annually. Bulk discounts apply for larger seat counts. Includes up to 5 family members per license. Organizations >300 seats require a demo/custom quote.

plans.name: Health (Enterprise)
plans.notes: Calm Health for health systems and large employers. Quote-only — no self-serve pricing published. Contact via demo request at health.calm.com.

vendors.name: Headspace
vendors.provenance: Apple App Store US listing (apps.apple.com/us/app/headspace-sleep-meditation/id493145008, accessed 2026-06-14) returned confirmed USD prices for individual monthly and annual tiers. Headspace's own pricing page (headspace.com/pricing) returned HTTP 404. Corroboration from mindbodygreen.com editorial listing (2023). Enterprise/organizations pricing confirmed as quote-only via organizations.headspace.com (accessed 2026-06-14).

plans.name: Plus Monthly
plans.notes: Month-to-month recurring. Full access to guided meditations, sleep content, focus music, and mindfulness courses. 14-day free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: Plus Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $69.99/year (~$5.83/month). Month-to-month rate is $12.99. Annual discount approximately 55% vs monthly. 14-day free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: For Organizations
plans.notes: Headspace for Organizations (B2B/employer benefits). Quote-only — no self-serve pricing published. Demo request required via organizations.headspace.com.

vendors.name: Insight Timer
vendors.provenance: Official Member Plus page (insighttimer.com/member-plus, accessed 2026-06-14) confirmed annual price of $60/year and 7-day free trial. Apple App Store US listing (apps.apple.com/us/app/insight-timer-meditation-app/id337472899, accessed 2026-06-14) confirmed monthly price of $9.99 and annual $59.99, plus MemberPlus Family at $89.99/year.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Permanently free. World's largest free meditation library with 100,000+ free guided meditations, music, and talks. No time limit on free tier. Premium courses (Insight Courses) require Member Plus upgrade.

plans.name: Member Plus Monthly
plans.notes: Month-to-month. Unlocks 7,500+ Insight Courses (10- and 30-day programs), offline listening, high-quality audio, and advanced player. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Member Plus Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $59.99/year (~$5.00/month). Month-to-month rate is $9.99. Annual discount approximately 50% vs monthly. 7-day free trial. Official site lists $60/year; App Store shows $59.99.

plans.name: MemberPlus Family Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $89.99/year (~$7.50/month). Family sharing plan via Apple Family Sharing for up to 6 members. Available through Apple App Store.

vendors.name: Balance
vendors.provenance: Apple App Store US listing (apps.apple.com/us/app/balance-meditation-sleep/id1361356590, accessed 2026-06-14) confirmed monthly ($11.99), annual ($69.99), and lifetime ($399.99) prices. Balance's own website (balanceapp.com) redirects to themindcompany.com/apps/balance which shows no pricing. Corroboration from mindbodygreen.com editorial review.

plans.name: Premium Monthly
plans.notes: Month-to-month. Personalized meditation plans, sleep content, and mindfulness coaching. First year free for new users (promotional offer as of 2024; may vary).

plans.name: Premium Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $69.99/year (~$5.83/month). Month-to-month rate is $11.99. Annual discount approximately 51% vs monthly.

plans.name: Lifetime
plans.notes: One-time purchase of $399.99 for permanent access. No recurring subscription. monthlyUsd is null because this is a one-time payment.

vendors.name: Waking Up
vendors.provenance: Official subscription page (wakingup.com/subscribe, accessed 2026-06-14) confirmed web-direct pricing: $19.99/month and $129.99/year. Apple App Store US listing (apps.apple.com/us/app/waking-up-guided-meditation/id1307736395, accessed 2026-06-14) shows $149.99/year — higher than web-direct due to Apple's platform fee; web-direct price is canonical. Scholarship program confirmed via wakingup.com homepage.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.notes: Pay-as-you-go monthly plan. Full access to guided meditations, courses, theory content, and conversations. 7-day free trial. Risk-free money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $129.99/year (~$10.83/month) via web-direct (wakingup.com). Apple App Store price is higher at $149.99/year due to platform fee. Month-to-month rate is $19.99. Web-direct discount approximately 46% vs monthly. Risk-free money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Scholarship (Free)
plans.notes: Full access granted at no cost to anyone who cannot afford the subscription. No questions asked — users self-certify financial need. Not a commercial tier; listed for completeness.

vendors.name: Happier (formerly Ten Percent Happier)
vendors.provenance: Official website (meditatehappier.com, accessed 2026-06-14) confirmed annual subscription at $99.99/year with 7-day free trial and free tier with 3 courses and 50+ meditations. Domain tenpercent.com redirects 301 to meditatehappier.com. No monthly plan published on official site. Corroboration from mindbodygreen.com editorial (2023) confirms ~$100/year.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Permanently free tier includes 3 full courses (Unlearn to Meditate, The Basics, The Dalai Lama's Guide to Happiness) plus 50+ guided meditations. No subscription required.

plans.name: Annual Subscription
plans.notes: Billed as $99.99/year (~$8.33/month). Annual-only billing model — no month-to-month option published. Unlocks all guided meditations (5–90 min), meditation courses, practice-in-action videos, wisdom clips, teacher talks, and podcasts. 7-day free trial.

vendors.name: Aura Health
vendors.provenance: Aura's official subscribe page (app.aurahealth.io/subscribe, accessed 2026-06-14) publishes an annual auto-renewal price of $59.99/year (with a discounted $41.99 first-year promo) but does NOT publish a monthly price. The annual figure (~$5.00/mo) is treated as confirmed. The previously listed $12.99 monthly came from stale 2023 mindbodygreen editorial and could not be confirmed against any official source — a 2025 third-party guide only estimates 'around $11.99/month' — so Premium Monthly monthlyUsd has been set to null pending a verifiable figure. aurahealth.io marketing homepage shows no pricing.
